Biography

LIVING BUDDHA JI KONG

Living Buddha JI KONG lived in the Southern Song dynasty (1150-1209), originally from Thien Thai district, Zhejiang province, family name Tu Duyen, took refuge at the temple Linh An in West Lake, Hangzhou, his dharma name is Dao Te. Because he often uses tricks to pretend to be crazy to save lives, people often jokingly call him Te Dien. The Living Buddha's body is the incarnation of the Arhat Golden Body, the Venerable Christmas Dragon, deeply understanding samadhi, that is, right concentration, calming the mind in meditation to achieve a state of carefree intuition in order to thoroughly comprehend and realize the Buddha Dharma, meaning: "All dharma

dharma originally appeared because of the mind" (All dharmas exist only in the mind). And directly cultivating the Buddha's mind without using means, it should be said: "Cultivate the mind without cultivating the mouth to become a living Buddha" (Cultivate the mind without cultivating the mouth, the monks and nuns at that time only "precepts of the mouth" and not "precepts of the mind", so the Living Buddha spoke a warning voice to help them become enlightened. He has great supernatural powers,
saves the world, is righteous in danger, and deals with the hypocrites.good people who specialize in doing evil things, he often makes fun of them to make them enlightened. But especially for those evildoers who did not know how to repent, he directly attacked without hesitation, making
people very happy, so people called him a

holy monk, worshiping him as the Living Buddha, it was certainly not by
coincidence.

The Living Buddha used to live in Tinh Tu Pagoda. The pagoda had a fire and needed wood for restoration. The Living Buddha traveled to Nghiem Lang, used his robe to cover the mountains, uprooted the trees and let them float to Hangzhou. He returned to inform the monks in the pagoda that "the wood is in the Huong Tich well".

Around the year Gia Dinh (1209), he passed away and was buried at Ho Pao tower. At his death, he composed a song:

Song written

Six Decades of Lang Ta
East Bich Da Dau Tay Bich
U Kim Gathers Quy Lai
Yu old water lotus sky wall.

Sing that

Sixty years of my life are in ruins. The eastern wall pushes against the western wall. Gathering forever still comes back empty-handed. The water suddenly turns blue and cloudy.

After entering nirvana, a monk met the Living Buddha at the foot of the Luc Hoa tower. In the letter sent back, there was attached a poem as follows:

Poetry

The memory of the front is the same as seeing off
The consciousness
Huu Qua Thien Thai passed away for a while.

Translation

Remembering the past in front of my eyes, blocking flying arrows
Why are my bones and flesh cold now
My face asks who can remember
My Thien Thai has come again to be happy.

So the Bodhisattva promised to return to earth. The Buddha lived his entire life to save and transform, walking around the human world to provoke anger and laughter, without worrying or shyness, cultivating "the practice of asceticism, practicing the Bodhisattva way, wearing a ragged robe, enjoying the worldly life. His torn shoes were soaked in mud, he held a fan in his hand, he was not afraid of high or low, the top of his head was shining brightly, the wind did not beat him, the rain did not bury him, so did he still need a conical hat? Vacuum, cold and heat do not penetrate

pham, what do you need for clothes? Don't beg for alms because you're not hungry or thirsty. Lazy and dignified because of the lack of fur, humorous and laughing, making good relationships widely, not hiding from the world, looking for a voice to save suffering, hundreds of families vying for respect, boundless compassion, wonderful virtue, no monk who has retreated to live in seclusion in the deep mountains and valleys can compare. Every word and every word is like a sharp thorn and taunting knife, leaving home from the tolerant intellectual region of Ngu Nhac, so in the next life any Buddha who considers himself noble will avoid talking about it. Therefore, a high level of holy monks was lost and could not be revealed. Fortunately, my Buddha was compassionate and did not complain, did not get depressed, lived beyond worldly attachments, demonstrated meditation everywhere, practiced Buddhism with full of joyful nuances, so the great name "Zen Master" resonated everywhere. The great spirit of the world transformed into positive merits of entering the world, is truly a shining example for those today who study Buddhism and practice the Way, so when life bestows the holy name "Living Buddha", it is very reasonable.

Nowadays, when the Dharma ends, sentient beings are burned by the fire of desire, immersed in the sea of ​​suffering. The Living Buddha is determined to save people, so the magical powers of the past are revealed again, vowing to reincarnate again, descending to the Holy Sage Hall, guiding the original spirit Yang Sheng to visit the underworld, collecting authentic evidence to warn the world. From there, the secrets of hell were revealed, creating magnetic boats to save sentient beings. Those who are blessed to be bathed in the rain of Dharma,

will forever stay away from evil paths. How great, the great work has been completed, it remains forever, remembering the great virtue.

WRITING VERSE

Confronting and singing, returning to the world of delusion
The first smile on the flower, the original magic of Zen
Life is like a play, acting with ecstasy and entering the fire
All dharmas return to the mind, transforming hell into paradise.
A life drama, playing the role of God and Buddha
Entering the mind of all dharmas, walking around hell and heaven.

“The mother resides in the Jade Pond of the Infinite Realm, her mind always thinks about the six directions, the four lives of reincarnation, seeing that everything is immersed and floating, although the physical form is different, the spirit is inherently formed by the same infinite energy. After the book of Hell's Journey was finished, the dawn of the earth dawned, Heaven's Journey completed, the door to heaven opened wide, people knew how to avoid hell and seek heaven, then it was considered successful in saving sentient beings, for one reason, there were many species of living beings, so in addition to saving humans, the law of salvation was not given to animals, so much flesh and blood, Mother could not bear to ignore it.

For that reason, now the Mother of God has issued an order to the Supreme Virtue Hall in Taichung and Living Buddha Ji Gong to guide the holy writer Yang Sheng to walk around the earthly world, interviewing the original spirits of animals and birds, to help people clearly see their past life actions that caused them to be reincarnated into animals in this life, to awaken people to stay away from the rolling tracks of the old wheel, from falling to the level of beasts. Today, God has given me a new mission, hoping to follow in the footsteps of Te Buddha to complete this great and difficult task to save all sentient beings. Holy virtue permeates all things, great humanity, all rely on that merit.

I hope that from the moment you start working, every time you start writing, you must take notes carefully until the book is completed before you can stop. I hope that the disciples of Thanh Duc Duong will be loyal and devote all their efforts to complete this strange and wonderful book, to help countless sentient beings. Respectfully obey without distraction, bow your head in thanksgiving. Fortune on February 8, Year of the Rooster (1981)

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva

Christmas

TITLE

Buffalo plowing the fields, dogs guarding the house, chickens waking up, goats milking, ducks for meat are the lives of animals. Lazy to cultivate, not keeping house, not trustworthy, not filial, not merciful, the above sins are countless in this world, because humans have long lived ungodly. Among sentient beings, only humans are the most difficult to save, so they can easily be reborn as animals, which makes us feel extremely sorry. I don't know how many people who have grown hair, have bald heads, and have been killed by humans. Everyone who has blood in them has compassion, compassion, and promotes vegetarianism and the precept of killing and releasing animals. That spirit of compassion to save suffering has touched the hearts of heaven and earth, touching the souls of all living things.

Nowadays, the Holy Duc Duong of Taichung is serving Dao Tri's command to establish a temple to promote religion. We especially bestow universal blessings and transmit the holy sect's mind dharma. All living beings will be imbued with aura and absorb immeasurable heavenly blessings through the Buddha's guidance of the holy writer Duong Sinh to interview animals and write the book "Record of Samsara", or "Journey to Samsara". After a year of hard work and hardship, for the ideal of improving morality and expanding compassion, gods and people were determined to sacrifice without regard for merit, thanks to which the book was finally completed successfully. The content of the book is fully recorded with evidence of guilt as narrated by the animals themselves. I believe that after reading it, people will definitely relent. Doing good or evil is free to choose according to each person's will; Being a human or an animal depends entirely on the mind. Animals and animals are fortunate enough to encounter universal salvation and enjoy boundless blessings, and have the opportunity to express their suffering, which is truly difficult, enough to prove that all living things inherently have equal Buddha nature, just because they are immersed in delusion.

Now, for the sake of all living things, I hope that people will put down the butcher's knife, abandon their greedy animalistic hearts, in exchange for the pure Buddha's mind, from now on free from animalistic behavior, treat others with kindness, treat others with integrity, not be greedy with their mouths and stomachs, eliminate the killing mind, then the world will be in peace and harmony, all living beings will be free from violence, there will be no more conflicts, the world will turn into a lotus Buddha country. Only then will people enjoy purity and things will be at peace, creating a garden of boundless pleasures in the mundane world.

After the Book of Travels was written, Tam Tao praised it and enthusiastically presented it; The six directions of samsara are joyfully spreading and chanting, countless sentient beings will one day end their suffering, create miracles, and establish immeasurably great virtue. My great vow to save sentient beings has temporarily seen results. I hope that sentient beings under the heavens will make a heart to print it, give it to each other, and read it from hand to hand to spread the Dharma, then the merit of helping sentient beings is truly immeasurable. While the book is published, I would like to respectfully offer a few words of praise for its merits.

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva's Preface at Taichung Holy Temple.

punishment! Dao Vong Linh in the Ming Dynasty had a poem that said:

Promoting virtue and charity is an urgent need in the eyes of society, and our teachers and students must make every effort to complete it. Light
The halo of the great path always shines upon us, do not disappoint the expectations of sentient beings, on the good path we must persevere in maintaining the path.

Duong Sinh: Thank you, teacher, for your advice. I promise to strictly follow it, but teacher, what method should I use to interview animals?

Buddhist worship: We not only interview the four species of animals such as those that give birth, those that lay eggs, those that live in the water, and those that crawl in the ground, because the species that the book Samsara Travels mentions, although their shapes are different, their spirit is like a source of electricity, with the same influence as the light of a lamp and the movement of machinery. Although the universe of all things has animals, plants, etc., in reality, their original spirits all originate from infinity, "one origin, dispersing all things", a root divided into thousands of others. But if you dig deep into the roots, you will see that its clue is the "principal spirit" which is "electricity". It's just a pity that people waste too much energy, causing their activities to go beyond the righteous path, so they increasingly pursue luxurious material things, their spirit is exhausted, causing too much material loss, supply is not enough to meet demand, and the risk of energy shortage is increasingly threatening.Scientists specializing in energy research have now also raised their voices to call for reducing energy use. This has clearly shown us that if humanity's raw energy energy is not reduced in wasteful consumption and further nourished, it will eventually be corrupted by material desires. If the mind is not regulated, it will be damaged and unable to be used, causing crazy neurological diseases. Science

The more we progress, the more our nerves weaken, so the mental hospital is expanding more and more. Therefore, it is necessary to save the original spiritual energy of humanity that is on the decline, to restore a healthy mind. The issue of cultivating talent and cultivating spirituality is one of the urgent tasks of religion. Cattle, chickens, ducks, fish, shrimp, worms, crickets, birds, flying animals, etc., they have lost their human form, they only have their spirituality and are still related to humanity, and are long-distance friends of humanity in life. Like loyal dogs, filial goats, loyal buffaloes, and German chickens, they have performed noble acts of sacrifice for humanity, so it can be proven that although their bodies are different from humans, they also have spirituality, blood, blood, and tears. We stand in the position that humans still want to understand more clearly, then of course animals also search for salvation, that is not a superstition, we just hope that everyone will admit that animals also have spirituality, then naturally this book Samsara Travel has research value.Immortals and Buddhas are people in the sacred world who are prophets and prophets, who represent the supreme spirituality. Wanting to learn about the spiritual life of animals is as easy as turning the back of your hand. Animals have many strange things to talk about, so they are very useful for learning. Someone who studies the spiritual life of animals is like a scientist using a microscope to examine the activities of bacteria. The eyes of living beings can only see activities

The periphery of an animal's body, as well as their mental activities, cannot be understood unless one has supernatural spirituality or an Immortal or Buddha with supernatural powers. Therefore, this book of Travels can be called "a book recording observations about the mental activities of animals". These are groundbreaking religious observations. In the era of civilized science, we must understand the living conditions of another world. Scientists have created satellites and spaceships, and religious practitioners must also use dharma vision and psychic dharma to find out and prove it. The journey into the sacred world of religion, with the purpose of improving humanity's spirituality so that humanity does not fall to the level of animality, advancing humanity to become Gods and Buddhas, helping mass society to preserve the Bodhisattva mind, compassion, everyone being happy, open and helping each other, not being bullied by big and small, only then can we hope to realize the theory of universal universality that Confucius once promoted.The virtuous person loves all creatures, the good person spreads favor everywhere, charity, greatness, compassion, joy and forgiveness cover humanity. Doesn't that create the picture "All creatures and I are one"?

Duong Sinh: Dear, the teacher's teachings just now are very reasonable. That is truly a wonderful sutra. After all sentient beings hear it, they will surely receive profound benefits and great enlightenment.

Praying to Buddha: The behavior of people today is even lower than animals, so the world's mouthpiece is often

said: "Animals dressed in animals" with animal hats and clothes to lower human dignity, praising dogs and horses as loyal, the reason is that today the heavens are universal, the true path has come down to earth, not only to save humanity back to infinity but also to restore the original spirits of animals that have accidentally lost their human form and physique back to their original form. Therefore, the issuance of orders in front of the book Samsara's Journey, one is to warn the world, and two is to enlighten living beings to complete the mission of the Three Taos of universal salvation. I hope that my words will be understood by sentient beings, that evil people will quickly reform their evil ways, so that evil will not abound, and reincarnation as another species will be truly fortunate.

Duong Sinh: The mind of a saint and all living things is one, Buddha teaches compassion, Confucius teaches forgiveness, Lao Tao teaches purity, God teaches charity, Islam teaches purity. The above teachings all advise not to rely on the strong to bully the weak, to keep the God-given character untarnished so that everyone can respect them. The heavenly virtue of love for life means a great spirit of kindness, we must promote that spirit of Dharma.

Buddhist worship: What the good student said is right, King Thanh Thang of the ancient Shang Dynasty, ruling his people, visited many times every year, asked questions about the people, clearly understood the cause of their suffering, and then preached Dharma for improvement. One day, amid the cool breeze, the sky was calm, all the birds were singing, and the herds were roaming about, King Thang came. He saw a group of hunters with cheerful faces, their hands spreading nets and traps, loudly declaring: "Some come down from heaven, some come up from the earth, some come from the four directions, all of them are caught.

into my net, no one can escape." King Thang could not hold back, so he proceeded to remove three sides of the net, leaving only one side, then he gave the teachings: "If you want to go to the left, go to the left; if you want to go to the right, go to the right; If you want to go up then go up, if you want to go down then go down, but if you don't want to live then go into the net." Hearing this, the hunter was very moved. The legend of the last three-sided open net spread throughout the world. People in today's world, those with evil hearts and habit of killing and plundering, must be moved to see this example of King Thang's love of life. People and animals are inherently one, they are species with the spirituality of all things, standing in the same position, we need to protect each other, good-hearted scholars. In many countries around the world, animal protection associations have been established with the same intention as mentioned above.The reason why I expressed the Bodhisattva's guts and guided Duong Sinh to interview the animals was to present the living situation of the animals, with the intention of encouraging people to nurture compassion, do good and avoid evil, and bring the theory of reincarnation and cause and effect of the four animal species to prove the truth of what I said, hoping that sentient beings would not consider it a superstition.

tieu_de: ACT TWO — THE SQUID DOG IS SAD AND ANGER HIMSELF CREATES EVIL KARMA — CATTLE SUFFERING HATE OF PREVIOUS LIVES RAGES
noi_dung:
ACT TWO

SAD AND ANGER SQUID DOG CREATES EVIL karma for himself

Suffering CATTLE HATE OF PREVIOUS LIFE

Living Buddha Ji Gong February 11, year of the Rooster (1981)

Poetry

Precepts to kill and release living beings for eternal life
Compassion nourishes the nature of being able to become immortal
Three sans sans fish flesh and flesh
To thai pure heart pure fairy wings.

Animals cultivate the Dharma with friendliness
Forbearance and suffering depending on the conditions, reciting hundreds of times
Completing the results of three worldly karma
Being generous with cause and effect separates the wise and foolish.

Translation

The precepts of killing live forever
Compassion nourishes to become an immortal
Eating fish and meat is delicious
But fresh vegetables are poor in keeping the mind clean.

Animal beings must cultivate
Patience depends on the fate of thousands of thoughts
Repaying debts to repay the kindness of three previous lives
The silky hair of cause and effect fulfills all hearts.

Buddhist worship: Even though animals no longer have human bodies, their spirituality is one with humans, living together in this world. It is only because the previous life's karma was too heavy, burying the "personality" that this life transforms in a different form, to appear in the physical world. Anyone who opens their wisdom eyes, or compassionate Taoists, does not have the heart to kill living beings. Buddhist scriptures say: "If the spirit is vibrating," if it moves, it has the original spirit. It must have been determined that anything that vibrates on the outside must have spirituality on the inside. Observing a dying person, when the holy spirit leaves the physical body, that person no longer has the power and cannot be revived again. Today, the teacher guides Duong Sinh around the world, interviewing the original spirits of animals, to hear them confess their feelings to help people understand. Duong Sinh, prepare to leave.

Duong Sinh: To go to heaven and go to hell, everyone rides a lotus flower, but today when walking on earth, I'm not sure which means of transportation will I use?

Buddhist worship: The lotus has flown in the air, waded in the water, and can now glide on the ground. However, the ashes are obscure,

but it does not cause much damage, because the lotus originally grew in mud and does not smell of mud.

Duong Sinh: Dear, your teacher is very correct, if there is no water, if the lotus still grows, then that lotus is truly a strange lotus.

Praying to the Buddha: That's right, without water the lotus still grows, it's because there is a rain of nectar dharma permeating it, let's see the master magically allowing the rain of nectar dharma to fall down.

Duong Sinh: Suddenly the rain of Dharma fell from the sky and washed the lotus flower clean, its vitality flourished, and it was like smiling. Dear teacher, the road is full of mud, full of potholes and dust, how can I get over it?

Buddhist worship: Ha ha, the lotus flower was originally born in muddy places, aren't those muddy puddles the filthy lotus ponds? Think of each stretch of road as a lotus hole. When it rains, noble people do not run away, but sit and rest. Perhaps only a few farmers, in order to protect their crops, have to wear raincoats and wade into the fields to cultivate. Immortals and Buddhas are like farmers, specializing in walking on muddy roads, replacing sentient beings to eliminate suffering, danger, illness, and afflictions. When faced with danger, they are determined to rush forward to demonstrate the Bodhisattva spirit of rescuing suffering. Even though they waste their efforts and are not liked by people, they will be blessed by their superiors. The lotus flower is also incarnated by Immortals and Buddhas, immersed daily in the world of suffering to save sentient beings. The path is bumpy and difficult to walk to test

to test the will of the cultivator. If he encounters hardships and hardships but is not discouraged, he still courageously advances, overcomes all obstacles, and finally reaches the immeasurable, infinite path. Come on Duong Sinh, get on the lotus platform, let's start our journey.

Duong Sinh: Please obey my orders, I respectfully invite my teacher to go on his way, to sit with him on the lotus, my heart is extremely light. The scene at night is very appropriate, lights are lit everywhere, houses are looming, new missions, new paths, to save sentient beings and promote enlightenment, gods and humans obey orders, not daring to be negligent and cause suffering to the teacher.

Praying to the Buddha: All sentient beings must keep in mind and remember, for who is suffering and who is suffering? And my heart is full of emotions, so I specially made a song to advise life:

“There are people who sacrifice both spiritually and materially, not enjoying happiness, working day and night to improve morality, touching everyone, making us feel moved. The happiness of sentient beings is not two-sided, we must join together to respond to the boat of kindness, show our morality and the way of heaven, quickly cultivate ourselves towards the top, don't brag loudly, don't show off loudly, we should do righteous deeds to prove that we are good people, so as not to be ashamed of the Immortals, Buddhas and heavens. Take off the cloak of desire, tear away the cloudy net, join hands to support Thanh Duc Duong, write books to advise people, lead people to happiness, happiness, and eternal joy.

Duong Sinh: The teacher's teachings are so reasonable, I am truly moved after hearing them.

Buddhist worship: We have arrived, quickly get down on the lotus.

Duong Sinh: Master, where is this?

Buddhist worship: This is in the suburbs of Kaohsiung.

Duong Sinh: Tonight, I knocked on the door. The owner was still awake, watching TV in the living room. The teacher and I came here, wondering if we would bother them?

Praying to the Buddha: We come by spirit, not by flesh, so they don't see, don't worry, what do you see now?

Duong Sinh: I saw a black dog near the door, sir, is that true? There seems to be another man next to him? It's really scary to see.

Praying to the Buddha: Don't be afraid, that person is you who just saw the original spirit of the dog, because you used your spiritual eyes to look at it, so you can see the human image, but not very clearly because your physical body still exists, so the spiritual body is obstructed, I will clear the eye point to help your eyes see the animal's original spirit clearly, so that you can freely talk with them.

Duong Sinh: Thank you, teacher.

Buddhist worship: “The left eye of the sun, the right eye of the moon, the sun and the moon contrast, see through all things, nothing can be hidden, clear the eyes and no more obstacles, see everything clearly, Um Ma Ni Bat Di Hong”.

Duong Sinh: Blessed Dharma Master, after reciting the mantra, the scene before my eyes has completely changed. The black dog that was lying still without moving has now clearly shown its human form, and is still prostrate on the ground, why?

Praying to the Buddha: Because of the crime, he cannot raise his head, so lying prostrate on the ground means being covered with dirty mud. People's feet walk on the ground, even though they wear thick sandals, but if they don't wash them for a day, the stench is still difficult to smell. This person's feet in his previous life were black and smelly, but he did not know how to take care of them and left his feet soaked in indigo. Therefore, in this life, he had to be reincarnated as a dog, walking on the ground on all fours, so all four limbs walked on dirty ground, head bowed in repentance. The reason why the back is facing the sky is because of a previous life that betrayed the sky, so one cannot walk or stand on two legs and cannot act like a human. Is that pitiful or not pitiful? Observe that criminals in society, when being photographed by journalists, bow their heads and hide their faces, not daring to look at anyone. When you were being led away in handcuffs, what was your appearance like at that time? Ha ha, I can't imagine too much compassion to avoid hurting your pride. Besides, people are only temporarily careless. If they slip and fall, you should forgive them. Only then can you be called a monk and accumulate positive virtue.

Duong Sinh: Looking at that person's appearance, he is very pitiful. Please, master, let them stand up so that they can escape the great disaster.

Buddha: Okay, I will enlighten them, that person in his previous life was called "Van Sinh" only because he refused to try to be an honest person, today he has to suffer like that. "I am the Living Buddha. Te Gong has given you a hint... have you awakened yet? Van Sinh, you can stand up now."

Van Sinh: Alas! My spine is paralyzed, I can't stretch, so I can't stand. I respectfully ask Living Buddha Ji Gong to rescue me.

To the Buddha: Today your family is blessed, I serve to instruct Duong Sinh to come here for an interview, quickly recount the mistakes you committed in your previous life, causing this situation today, to advise people in the world to avoid stepping on your footsteps, only by doing so can you make amends, and soon one day you will be reincarnated and reincarnated as a human.

Van Sinh: Yes, but I respectfully ask the Living Buddha to help me stretch my spine, otherwise when I move and stand up, it will be extremely difficult and miserable.

Buddhist worship: Okay, let me exchange your bones, I will change your animal bones into human bones, so you can walk and stand easily.

Van Sinh: I respectfully bow to you ten thousand times.

Buddhist worship: You must patiently endure the pain. When exchanging bones, do not squeeze alcohol or medicine, then the wound will heal quickly. I'm starting to take action...

Van Sinh: Oh, it hurts! I am dying, please quickly replace my bones because my whole body is almost paralyzed.

Buddhist worship: It's true that your bones lack air, I changed you to an artificial skeleton, now you can stand. Most of the bones of people born today are bad, because the bones are filled with evil energy. When the weather is not favorable, it is very painful, that is also a punishment.

Van Sinh: I would like to thank the Living Buddha for exchanging my bones. I can now stand, but my back still aches. Can I use more "anti-inflammatory" medicine to reduce the pain and soreness?

Buddhist worship: Do not use medicine, let's use a Bo fan to fan a few times to naturally relieve the cold, dissipate the heat and immediately relieve the pain. "Ha ha, fan Bo generates cool wind, the pain and swelling are gone... no pain, no pain like that."

Van Sinh: Thank you, Living Buddha, indeed my whole body feels as refreshed as in my previous life as a human.

Duong Sinh: Why is your family exiled in this place?

Van Sinh: It would be even more embarrassing to say it out loud, it would be better not to say it.

Duong Sinh: Don't be afraid, the living Buddha's benefactor has liberated you. Quickly tell your past actions clearly to set an example for people, it must be of immeasurable merit.

Van Sinh: Dear, if so, I would like to tell the story of my life that caused me to fall and be reincarnated as a dog so that people can understand, to avoid the mistakes that I have committed. In my previous life, I was a dishonest person, a gangster,

borrowed the reputation of security guards and forced the owners of tea rooms, dance halls and prostitution shops to pay money. Therefore, I became a prostitute who indulged in alcohol. Sometimes, because I was so greedy for money, I had the audacity to seduce and threaten even daughters from good families to sell themselves to prostitutes. During this time, there was a girl selling powder and incense named Tu Lien, meaning beautiful lotus. At first, I stole her virginity and then made a plan to sell her to the village to become a prostitute. She trusted me with her fate, but I treated her like a toy. She foolishly believed in my pretense of love, so for five or six years she sold her meat to get money for me to gamble and spend. Her blood and bone money was wasted by me. One day, her beauty faded, I could no longer take advantage of her, and then I squeezed the lemon to remove the peel, so I could easily continue that demonic trick with other girls in the same situation. In my poor life, I earned too much money, beauty, and harmed many girls and women and destroyed many people's families.Tu Lien, the beautiful lotus, was deceived like that, so how could she survive, and I ended up suffering from a venereal disease, with no medicine to cure it, and finally had to die. After the moment I left my life, I was escorted by impermanent black and white demons to the underworld. The King of Hell decided on a heavy punishment. After being tortured in all prisons, I was finally taken to the ten palaces of Minh Vuong, where I was sentenced to be reincarnated as a dog in the human world. Because the world is a place where I have done many evil things,

must return to pay for his sins and suffer all his life to correct himself. I was reincarnated as a dog twice. In this life, I was reincarnated as a dog of the Tran family. I was truly in a desperate situation, because this family was very poor and dirty, they poured so many stinking things on me, were beaten by their children, every time I entered the house I was kicked out, I had to stay outside to guard the door, help clean up the children's feces, eating dirty food was not fun but I had to try to swallow it, not eating was much more miserable. The first time I was reincarnated as a dog when being slaughtered by the old man was truly terrifying. The wooden pestle hit my head, boiling water poured over me, sharp knives dissected, chopped into hot pots, fried, stewed with the name "humiliation" and fragrant meat. I was currently heartbroken, but my crime was so serious that I didn't know if there was any way to solve it? I hope people don't make the same mistake I did, because if you betray heaven, you will definitely be exiled and suffer. Must remember that evil actions are not known when I will be reincarnated as a human being? If I were reincarnated as a human being, I would be willing to be the one who holds the heavens and the earth, and does not dare to act dishonestly or unjustly.In my previous life, because I intentionally caused women to bleed and shed meat, I was in big trouble in this life. The butcher thought that it was very nutritious because people like to eat fragrant meat. In my previous life, I also took care of nourishing myself, so today, being a fattening animal for others, there is no way to complain.

Duong Sinh: Master, he has repented and asked you to save him.

Praying to the Buddha: I have already converted your family's bones, waiting for the end of the world. When you reach Minh Phu, you will naturally be reborn. You should patiently pay off all your debts in this life, cultivate merit, and wait for the next life. When people see this scene, they must be awakened, because the money, wealth, and possessions that have been deceived and robbed from others are all borrowed. If it is not honest, it must one day be returned, not even a single thread or hair is missing. Naturally, honest and simple people want to drink the northwest wind. The ancients said: "Genius and foolishness are the same", harming people is a disaster, saving people is a blessing. This quote is very reasonable, people should take it as an example. Duong Sinh prepares to return to Thanh Duc Duong.

Duong Sinh: Sir, I'm ready. I respectfully invite you to leave.

Buddhist worship: Having arrived at Thanh Duc Hall, Duong Sinh descended into the lotus, his soul entering his body.

tieu_de: ACT THREE — VU PISSES VU WITH ONLY SOFT LIPS AND TONGUE — Swallow CONVERSATION Awakens people's hearts
noi_dung:
ACT THREE

ANH VU PISSES THE VOLUME WITH ONLY THE SOFT LIPS AND TONGUE

THE Swallow's Formal Dialogue AWAKENING PEOPLE'S HEARTS

Living Buddha Te Gong Christmas February 12, year of the Rooster (1981)

Poetry

Thousands of thousands of leaves and roots
One point of origin and ten thousand ancient existences
Infinity divides the whole world
Ten thousand Buddhas give thanks to heaven.

Cultivate the body and practice the primordial spirit
Free from the teachings of dead souls falling to beasts
The old man's way of studying the way
The urban youth of Africa.

Translation

Thousands of branches and thousands of leaves have the same source
A point of eternal origin
Infinity divides the whole world
Thousands of Buddha-born houses feel heavenly grace.

Correct yourself and practice your spirit
The spirit of an animal is saved from falling into the body
Don't think that when you get old you can learn the Dharma
Evil roots are often created in youth.

Praying to Buddha: The world is fortunate to be human, to be revered as a sacred species among all things, and is extremely honored at present. Knowing how to sew clothes, build houses, manufacture cars, airplanes, ships, television, and radio recordings, material needs are not only increasingly abundant, but also modified to be more refined and beautiful. As for animals, from the moment they are born, the fur they wear until they die is just that, not changing at all. Therefore, being born as a human is truly fortunate, but if you do not live as a human being, act illegally, harm others, bury your personality, eventually one day you will change your face and be reincarnated as an animal. Today, I guided my good student Duong Sinh to interview animals, which was really unique, because people in the world cannot talk to animals, not only that, but they also don't believe it, thinking it's a myth, everything said cannot be true. Therefore, it is necessary to learn how zoologists in zoos guide animals on a daily basis. Horses jump around, dolphins perform, among these species fish understand a little human language and know signs, so

Each of their movements seems so lucid, their technique is so high, sometimes we have to honestly admit that even if humans practice, they are still inferior to them! They are similar to humans in that they all have spirituality, people should not underestimate them! This travel book also wants people to respect their good friends, animals. If you want to progress, you should not hold them back. Also, do not act inhumanly or virtuously, causing chaos and creating unhappiness for society. If you only think about destroying, injuring, deceiving, robbing, deceitful, insulting, killing, bewitching, fighting, and destroying, then you are no longer worthy of being a human being! The above human beings are inhumane, unjust, immoral, with the appearance of humans and the appearance of beasts, with a gentle appearance but with a deep heart. When condemned by public opinion, they will one day encounter a miserable situation and fall to be reincarnated as an animal. If the world loved, helped, supported, and encouraged each other everywhere, everyone would enjoy blessings. If the human mind is a Bodhisattva's mind, then surely after leaving the body, it will become a Saint, an Immortal, or a Buddha, because a pure mind will rise high, an evil mind will sink, and that is where the boundary between animals and humans lies.Do people want each step to go up or down? You are all very smart, why do you want to be a bird in a cage? Who doesn't want to be free and unfettered, so don't commit crimes to avoid falling into the dungeon. Duong Sinh quickly climbed to the lotus platform so that he and his team could interview a new witness.

Duong Sinh: Sir, I've finished preparing. I'm not sure where the teacher will guide me for the interview today?

Buddha worship: Wait a moment and you will understand, let's go... We've arrived, this is the bird shop.

Duong Sinh: The scene here is like the street scene in Taichung.

Buddha: Yes, please observe the birds kept in iron cages, all kinds of birds, extremely noisy.

Duong Sinh: Each cage is like a family, they live exactly like husband and wife, children are reunited, some are like friends, why are they gathered together in one place like that?

Te Buddha: Because there is a karmic relationship with each other, look closely, you will clearly see the strange thing, I have hinted and restored their past life memories for you to interview...

Duong Sinh: It is truly miraculous, after the master gave the blessing, the birdcage turned into a house with rooms, the people in it wore beautiful clothes, some were dancing. During meals, some people rest, but the house has no chairs but only hanging bamboo branches, water bottles and cereal bowls. Because there is no bridge, excretion is haphazard and unhygienic.

Buddhist worship: This birdcage is their home. Because it is not neat and hygienic, germs often enter the body, causing illness. Human life is full of amenities and hygienic food, unlike birds, whose food is often mixed with feces. A person's place of residence has a room, a bed and chair with soft cushions, comfortable to lie down and sit on,

And the birds sleep on tree branches in the jungle or on the banks of streams, roaming grass to nest, eat, and excrete in the same place, that life is truly the life of a criminal, of a prisoner. Today, I instruct good students to come here and interview the birds to hear their heart's groans. Duong Sinh, please ask questions.

Duong Sinh: Hey bird, why are you locked in a cage like this? Can you clearly state the reason to create an opportunity to make amends?

Mr. Vu: Dear, I wear a blue shirt, have the red lips and beak of a robin, I really didn't expect to be this reckless today. In my previous life, I was a woman, had a habit of talking too much, making sarcastic comments, making enemies, and all my life creating resentment with my neighbors. When they had small quarrels, I would add more oil to make them fight each other. One time, my neighbor was visiting her mother when a girlfriend came to visit. I saw that her husband seemed intimate with that friend, and even invited her to stay for a meal. The next day when she returned, I immediately told her: "You were away, your husband brought his girlfriend home, and then there were some shady sexual acts." So the couple fought and ended up divorcing each other. Later, the husband sadly fell ill with liver failure. Not only that, I also considered going into business. In the end, when I failed, I blamed heaven and earth. My life had indeed created too much bad karma. After the waterfall, Minh Vuong was so angry that he scolded me for being a kiss saboteur

Human person, telling lies, cursing heaven and earth, must be punished for more than ten years, after completing his term, he must be reincarnated as a bird, wearing a red beak, learning to speak human language, his tongue choking day and night. Locked in a cage, although I can eat well but cannot fly in the sky, my soul is truly sad. Today the Living Buddha is here, please show compassion and save me from this iron cage.

Teacher Buddha: Ha ha, you are used to living in a cage, now there are buildings everywhere, even if you were to let you out, you still wouldn't be able to live, Buddha's compassion cannot let you go and let you die, you should accept this fate and try to live here for the rest of your life. You have made a contribution in recounting the mistakes of your past lives to record them in the book Samsara Travel as an example for people in the world. Surely after you pass away, you will be reincarnated as a human. Try to practice more, don't be dissatisfied with your current situation.

Duong Sinh: Dear master, there are so many species of birds, I don't know what crime they committed that led them to be reincarnated as birds like this?

Buddhist worship: In general, birds are not entirely created by people who have reincarnated, but some are created by the essence of the sun and moon, so they can fly in the air. Because the sun and moon are two boundless masses of energy, when the solar energy and the lunar energy meet, many qualities can arise in the sky and earth.

linh. There are many primordial spirits of birds that, by absorbing the sacred energy of the sun and moon, gradually evolve into human primordial spirits, cultivating and becoming enlightened. Many Immortals and Buddhas originally came from animals. Because animals can coexist with Immortals and Buddhas, it proves that all creatures are spiritual, and as long as you practice diligently, you can reach the supernatural realm and enter the sainthood. Nowadays, humanity is reproducing more and more, so every country is calling for birth restrictions, some people ask: "Where do people come from and there are more and more people every day?". Today I explain as follows: The seeds that give birth to all living things are increasingly evolving, and many animal species in the world are being destroyed. Human intelligence is improving day by day, the field of life is becoming larger and larger day by day, so the living space of small, weak creatures is invaded by humanity. In the end, the only way to survive is to reincarnate as a human being, which is why the human race is growing in number every day. Because most humans have just reincarnated from animals and have not yet had time to wash away their old nature, the world today is morally degenerate, and many people have human-like, animalistic behavior, and have animalistic behavior that harms the heavens.The population is rapidly increasing and the world's energy shortage is a constant threat, so many people propose cultivating the religion and cultivating character, so that they can fly completely to the pure realm, which religions often call heaven in the West. tieu_de: CHAPTER TWELVE — WITH ANIMALS OF DIFFERENT SPECIES BUT THE SAME CHARACTER — WARM WOOL TO COVER THE BODY MUST REMEMBER THE GRACE OF THE SHEEP
noi_dung:
ACT TWELVE

WITH ANIMAL PEOPLE WITH DIFFERENT SPECIES BUT THE SAME CHARACTER

WOOL TO COVER THE BODY MUST REMEMBER THE GRACE OF THE SHEEP

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas on September 12, Year of the Rooster (1981)

Poetry

The ethics of cultivating the blessings of the future
The Tam Duong Khai Thai Choi mountain song
The joy of the human family in fullness
The World great dong scared star three.

Entering the path of reincarnation and suffering from suffering ghosts
Receiving the first cause, bringing joy to the Buddha
Knowing the future is good because of the good cause
Reciting Buddha's teachings freely.

Translation

The morality of cultivating and painting brings peace
The music of the three worlds is harmonious
Everyone is happy and has a warm home
Humanity is the same, the waves are calm.

Being reincarnated into an animal life has countless sufferings
Beaten by people filled with tears
Contemplate carefully how to be a human being but cherish
Tieu dao freely chants Guan Yin.

Praying to Buddha: The difference between animal life and human life can be compared to the abyss and the sky. Modern civilization values ​​human life, animals are loved, precious dog breeds are raised and cared for extremely attentively by those with money. But in general, animals are still at a lower level than humans, controlled by humans, the life and death of humans are determined by humans, and animals are controlled by humans, so they are often killed by humans, that is where humans win over animals. I hope that people will protect their vocation to be human, to avoid committing animal-like acts, because those who commit crimes will be beaten, exiled, and executed in extreme horror, considered equal to animals, and deprived of their human rights. From the time the book Samsara was written until now, everyone who reads it has been startled and awakened. Evil people see it broken, good people see respect and do not dare to go down the wrong path. This book has the effect of advising the world, awakening the world, enlightening the world, hoping that people will not consider it trivial.

Duong Sinh: There are skeptics who believe that animals and humans are not related at all, so how can we discuss with

them? They think animals are just flesh and blood, and spirituality does not exist. If we discuss this topic and write it down in a book, it will be remembered for thousands of generations.

Buddhist worship: Most people are short-sighted, in the past there was Cong Da Trang, who understood the sound of birds, and often talked to birds. Chung Tu Ky only listened to Ba Nha's music and understood his friend's feelings, so he called him "friends". Furthermore, the white crane of the Antarctic fairy can understand the voice of the fairy, and the heavenly dog ​​of former master Duong Tien can understand the voice of the master. Quan Am riding a dragon, Zen Master riding a tiger, the two appearances of a turtle and a snake at the feet of God Huyen Thien, don't they all prove that gods and animals are one and the same? If animals do not have spirituality, how can they reach heaven and live and reside with Immortals and Buddhas?

There are animals that are trained, can hear people's voices, work for people, keep house, perform games, and learn what people tell them. Through the ancient evidence mentioned above, it must be clear that although animals do not have human bodies, their spiritual similarity cannot be denied.

Each animal has its own voice, it's just a pity that ordinary people don't understand it. Ants bow their heads to the ground to transmit their voices, birds in distress cry out, their fellows hear and understand immediately. Both people and animals have places of confusion, people cannot understand the voices of animals, animals hear people talking to each other

and do not understand the magic, so they think of people as other animals similar to themselves. People should not despise animals.

I guide Duong Sinh to discuss with animals because I use Buddha's teachings, helping them restore their original spirit, so they can speak human language. For example, we guided Duong Sinh to interview an American, and everyone knew that how could we have a conversation when speaking English? In fact, all spiritual animals can learn to speak all kinds of languages ​​of different countries. Because I gave the Buddha's Dharma to give animals more spirituality so that they can speak human language, just like a spiritually intelligent person can speak Chinese, English, German, and French.

Every country has zoos and animal teachers, but each country teaches its own language that the animals still understand equally, enough to prove that animals all have spirituality, they just need to be developed and trained to adapt immediately. To take an example of modern science and technology, using radar one can see a tornado moving from afar.

Humans and animals both have minds, waves emanate from the brain, just need more instructions, then humans and animals have similarities. The wave emitted from the brain is an electric wave. In intelligent animals, this wave is a thousand times richer than normal people, so Buddhism considers the reincarnation of animals to be one of six paths. class="book-paragraph">If animals cannot communicate by language with humans, then the theory of six paths of reincarnation is untenable, the animals at the lotus feet of the Immortals and Buddhas in the Western world are not real. Therefore, the saint said:

“All things with me are one” (All things are evil and self is one) must have
explained that the heaven and earth of all things do not divide spirituality and
nature, with spirituality we treat with good, with nature we use
goodness. A bowl of rice makes a sumptuous meal, a pair of glasses brings light, all these things
is the expression of the nature of things, as things of nature, you must use kindness to use them, don't despise them and throw them away. Since the nature of things is like that, can the spiritual nature be denied? Saints consider animals as people and should treat them with compassion. For example, in the south of our province, there are people who love to kill many birds for fun. The officials and the current government once again issued a notice banning the catching and killing of birds, because eating a piece of meat means killing a life. Catching a bird can only sell for ten dong, which is too small a profit. Birds also have the right to live, killing them indiscriminately not only hurts human love but also destroys natural life and destroys charity.

What has just been presented clearly explains the theory of human rule, that is, using virtue to rule, everyone must treat animals with compassion. Heaven is inherently fond of life, if people feel

of the favor of heaven, promote virtue, and practice the things presented in this book, it will be praised as a precious sutra, aiming to develop the virtue of compassion and charity.

The person who lost a small chicken searched everywhere, the person who caught the chicken and killed it felt happy; Hitting and killing people is not a shame, but when a mosquito bites you, you feel angry. Compare your mind with your mind to see if your mind is good or not? The previous point of evidence shows that the human mind is selfish and inhuman, the mind is an extraordinary animal, and deserves to be considered a friend of humanity. They sacrifice their lives to feed humanity. Humanity should not be ungrateful. The book Samsara and Journey proves that the soul is immortal and reincarnation is true. I hope that people in this world will not let their consciences be filled with evil deeds, and must be upright and upright people to avoid being reincarnated as animals to be killed and commanded by others. In short, the purpose of this book is to warn good people to stay away from evil and not to act cruelly like animals.

Duong Sinh: The Master has worked hard to prove the truth to help people understand the law of reincarnation. Animals also have their own heaven and earth. This book, Traveling Records, has clearly presented it to help people understand correctly about animals. The evidence is very consistent with such reasoning.

Buddhist worship: Duong Sinh quickly go up to the lotus, prepare to move to another place for more interviews.

Duong Sinh: Master, where are you going?

Buddhist worship: Go abroad to check the situation.

Duong Sinh: Dear teacher, which country are we going to?

Buddha worship: Go to New Zealand to interview sheep.

Duong Sinh: It would be great to travel on this occasion, today the weather suddenly turned cold, New Zealand wool is very famous, I must buy some to weave clothes to wear.

Praying to the Buddha: Your calculations are really smart, let's go on our way... Having arrived, Duong Sinh got down on the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: There are many sheep here, each of them has thick and long hair compared to sheep from other countries, not sure why it has so much hair?

Buddhist worship: Sheep's wool grows from the sheep's body, there is a lot of wild grass here, it is very convenient for raising sheep, if sheep want to keep their body warm, they must grow a lot of hair, that is also a miraculous arrangement of nature.

Duong Sinh: Winter has come, people who want to avoid freezing to death must wear sweaters, so providing wool to knit warm clothes and sheep has helped humanity a lot. Sir, can I ask you about the sheep's life?

Te Buddha: I came here today to interview them to understand their background. "Sheep! Sheep! Your body is full of hair, you are wearing a warm coat given by the Creator. Please tell us clearly about your background. I give you a wonderful Dharma to awaken your spiritual nature so that you can tell the story of your past life to admonish people."

Duong Sinh: The sheep, after receiving the Buddha's Dharma from their teacher, have awakened, I would like to interview them. Please tell me how you feel after being reincarnated as a sheep?

Sheep: In my previous life, I was a corrupt person who committed the crime of killing many people, so in this life I was reincarnated as a sheep.

Duong Sinh: What is corruption like?

Sheep Giap: In my previous life, I was a mandarin and was entrusted with overseeing the construction of a bridge. For my own benefit, I colluded with the contractor to reduce labor and reduce cement, gravel, iron and steel, etc. by up to one-third, not building the correct amount of materials according to the architect's design plan to pocket money. Once the bridge was built, a lot of money was collected from passersby. One time, floods fell from the mountains, the bridge collapsed, and pedestrians and vehicles on the bridge fell into the river and were drowned by the water. Because of that crime of murder, in this life I had to be reincarnated as a sheep, with my whole body covered in hair. When the long hair was cut off with scissors, people sold it to other countries to make wool to weave clothes. For a lifetime, I only knew how to grow long hair and donate it to people to pay off debts from my previous life.

Duong Sinh: If you are greedy for a hair, you will pay for a hair. If you are greedy for millions, you will have to pay for how many decades?

Army Sheep: If you betray your integrity, you must pay for your dishonesty. If you live, you will grow long hair that year to repay your debt, without uttering a word of complaint.

Duong Sinh: Knows how to repent and repay the debt, believing that the debt will definitely be paid.

Praying to the Buddha: You recounted what you did in your previous life, making the listener's soul cold, because of you, so many people had to do bad things. In this life, try to give people fur coats to protect against the cold and keep their bodies warm, that is paying back the evil karma.

Duong Sinh: Please ask another sheep, why did you have to be reincarnated in this place?

Sheep At: Thank you Buddha Te Buddha and Duong Thien Sinh for paying attention to me and helping me stay awake. In my previous life, I was a merchant who specialized in selling fake wool, domesticated fabrics and lying that they were foreign products. Customers who bought them said they were precious fabrics and were willing to buy them at high prices, so they were deceived. Not only did they not know, but they also expressed their happiness. All my life I specialized in selling bad fabrics and saying they were good fabrics to make a lot of profit. I married two wives and enjoyed full happiness throughout my life. When I was alive, I did not believe in cause and effect, but after I died, I was extremely scared when I stood in front of the mirror to reflect my bad karma. I endured all the painful punishments from the King of Hell and was reincarnated as a sheep in a foreign country. The hair on my body is also my body's clothing, eating grass, absorbing nutrients so the hair grows long, just in time to become a beautiful outfit, people strip it naked to weave it into wool to knit clothes, so it can be said that I only plow and do not harvest. As soon as I put on my clothes, I have to take them off, which is really unfortunate.

Buddhist worship: Do not harbor resentment, your fur clothes cannot be worn for long because you are unlucky. Who told you to sell fake fabrics in your previous life, so in this life you have to give genuine products and 100% genuine wool to people in this life to eliminate their karma.

Sheep At: Listening to Buddha Te's teachings, my heart feels extremely regretful. In my previous life, I had glory and wealth, but I only enjoyed it for a few decades. In this life, I had to be exiled in the wilderness, suffering from rain, sun, and wind to produce wool for people to sell, but I didn't get a dime. I could only blame myself!

Duong Sinh: Please ask that sheep again, why did you have to reincarnate as a sheep?

Cuu Binh: In my previous life, I opened a bank, I forced people to borrow money at very high interest rates, everyone who urgently needed to borrow money from me had to accept high interest rates, so it can be said that that benefit is "blood-boosting", eating a meal from me makes blood flow to the throat, like being stabbed by me. Because they were in dire straits and needed my help, they wouldn't accept any conditions. I took this opportunity to ask to have sex with their wives and daughters. They were blatantly forced to, but they had to swallow their hatred and grit their teeth to accept. Taking advantage of their danger to rob them of their wealth and beauty, they violated the law of heaven. After death, they were banished to the underworld to suffer harsh punishments, and reincarnated as sheep. Their exile in this place was truly miserable. In my previous life, I was rich, had a luxury car and a beautiful girl, but now

is empty-handed, reincarnated as another species, I have hair, I have horns on my head, I am unbearably ugly.

Duong Sinh: Dear teacher, every time you lend money to make a profit, it's a crime, right?

Buddhist worship: It is impossible to conclude like that. It is not a crime for a bank to lend money for profit. If it lends money to help people, does not take meritorious profits, and takes small profits, then it is not a crime. With the purpose of helping people in need overcome difficulties, it is like helping people in half. On the contrary, taking a lot of money from people in danger is considered evil, inhumanity, taking advantage of people in danger and need to commit adultery with their wives and children would violate the law of heaven. What has just been presented is true, the proverb says: "The wool grows on the sheep's body." To look down on others is to devalue yourself, to harm others is to harm yourself, the above evidence is a lesson to warn people, they should try to be a decent and honest person, they will definitely reap good fruit. If you are deceitful, deceitful, and corrupt, not only is life's law unforgivable, but heaven's law also hates it. If you refuse to be an honest person, in your next life you will be damned by heaven and suffer all the bitterness and suffering. You have recounted all your sins and advised others to do good deeds. I bless you to be reincarnated as a human in your next life, but do not forget to keep your religion to avoid being reincarnated as an animal again. Duong Sinh prepares to return to Thanh Duc Duong.

Duong Sinh: Dear, I have ascended to the lotus, I respectfully invite you to depart.

Buddhist offerings: Having returned to Thanh Duc Hall, Duong Sinh descended into the lotus, his soul entering his body.

tieu_de: CHAPTER THIRTEEN — KNOWING THE PAIN OF ANIMALS AND WORRYING FOR THEIR LIFE — IN THE FOREST IN THE MOUNTAIN WITHOUT A HOME, REPENTING FOR THE OLD TIMES
noi_dung:
APPEARANCE THIRTEEN

Knowing the pain of animals, worrying about their lives

IN THE FOREST IN THE MOUNTAIN WITHOUT A HOME REPENTING FOR THE OLD TIMES

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas on September 24, year of the Rooster (1981)

Poetry

Heaven and earth love natural dharma
Animals and spirits have no natural nature
Blood and flesh are called brotherhood.
Double-shaped shapes spread across the great sky.

All good things do not know the mind of love
Sacrificing people, taking advantage of things to save oneself, reciting
In time, saving things, letting go of the past
After the day, we will deeply repay gratitude.

Translation

Heaven and earth are naturally lovable
The original spirit of animals is inherently docile
Blood and blood are brothers
If we are different, our hearts should not be divided.

Not knowing how to do good opens the heart
Helping people and animals avoid worries
In this life, support and forgive
In the next life, make up for it through gratitude.

Buddhist worship: Recently, my heart feels really good when I hear schools launching movements to protect nature. The school issues exam questions for students that encourage the development of love for animals, so the influence spreads to every family, everyone expands their love for animals, and the field of animal survival is naturally expanded. The sea is wide and the sky is high, we can travel everywhere, that is the wish of all things and people.

Unless animals have harmful behavior, they need to be punished to protect their safety. Killing them to eat meat or to satisfy their desire to kill is a barbaric act. The civilized world must promote kindness and generosity, and if we do not kill, there will definitely be a day when animals will become extinct. I agreed to join Duong Thien Sinh in writing the book Samsara Travel to promote people's love for animals. I am also very happy to see famous people exhorting to protect animals, which is an action that "pleases heaven, pleases people, and is extremely beneficial to animals". This is enough

to prove that the book Samsara Travel is very useful for life, the world should not underestimate it. Duong Sinh prepares to depart.

Duong Sinh: Dear sir, I have ascended to the lotus, I respectfully invite you to depart.

Buddhist worship: Today we went on a tour of Africa, the road is quite far.

Duong Sinh: Riding on a lotus to Africa for free is a strange story.

Buddhist offerings: The spiritual world is not far from the Buddha's realm, so people must focus on cultivating spirituality, so that when it comes out of the physical body like an electric current, the light flows quickly to the noble realm, and Immortals and Buddhas always help people with supernatural abilities. Cultivating to this realm, life and death are naturally one, not bound by the fate of reincarnation. Well, let's go straight to Africa... We've arrived.

Duong Sinh: This place is a desolate forest, at first glance I feel scared.

Buddha: Don't be afraid, I'm here.

Duong Sinh: In front there is a group of tigers, they are glaring, looking extremely ferocious, can they avoid being eaten by them?

Praying to the Buddha: We came here by body dharma, there is no way for the tiger to eat us, don't be afraid.

Duong Sinh: Tigers born in the wild are very ferocious.

Today, my teacher and I interviewed these tigers, so that I could teach them the Dharma to enlighten them first: "Tiger, tiger, tiger, tiger! Don't show your ferocity anymore, be gentle again, no one dares to come close to you, isn't that so lonely and wild? Duong Sinh: Tiger was given a hint by the master, clearly showing the shape of a person in his past life, male and female, looking very cruel, wanting to cause aggression against others.

Holy Buddha: Duong Sinh can interview them.

Duong Sinh: I am the saintly writer Duong Sinh of Thanh Duc Duong in Taichung, following the teacher Te Buddha before writing the book Samsara Travel to advise people. Today I'm specially here for an interview, I hope you will explain clearly the cause and effect of your past life, the possibility of making merits to atone for your sins, being reincarnated as a human in your next life, and having to live through the scenes of heaven and earth amidst the deep forests and mountains, please tell us quickly.

Cop Giap: In my previous life, I was a highlander, belonged to a tribe living in the forest, had a rough and healthy body, specialized in hunting wild animals to live like other uncivilized people. they burned to the ground. Because there was no law, I was not punished. After death and going to the underworld, the body was cut into many pieces and put into a cauldron to cook. After that, he had to be reincarnated as two animals, the previous life was a lion, this life was a tiger living in the forest and suffering endlessly.

Praying to the Buddha: Your animalistic nature is too ferocious, killing people like killing animals, without any humanity, tyrannical behavior, specializing in eating animals, eating too much has become a habit, in this life, living in the forest and continuing to force other creatures to eat will also create bad karma. I hope that from now on, you will awaken your mind, get rid of your animalistic nature, quickly abandon your old nature and establish a new one. In your next life, you will be reincarnated as a human being, but you will have to endure poverty and work hard to atone for your sins.

Cop Giap: Thanks to Living Buddha Ji Gong and Duong Thien Sinh, in my next life I will be a person who will definitely try to cultivate myself and not dare to do evil to avoid forever going down an evil path.

Duong Sinh: Let me ask another person, how did you do evil things in your past life?

Cop Giap: In my previous life, I was a bandit, specializing in robbing and killing people, raping and burning houses, doing every evil thing on a regular basis. Killed two people, injured thirteen people, robbed two million, set fire to the house twice, raped women three times, all his life he did not worry about doing honest business, only worried about crushing people's heads and strangling them, countless people suffered. When fate arrived, because of the crime of murder, the police searched

harshly, fled into the mountains, and robbed the living mountain people. One day, while sleeping under a tree in the forest, he was bitten by a snake. Because there was no medicine to treat him, he did not dare to go out of the mountain and ask someone to treat him, so he had to lie down and die in the mountain. After death, the mountain god escorted him to hell, handed him over to the King of Hell to punish him, suffered many painful punishments, and was then reincarnated as two snakes, one tiger, one buffalo, and then reincarnated as a human. The life of a snake is over, this life is a tiger in Africa, thinking about it makes me extremely regretful.

Buddhist worship: It is truly as ferocious as a tiger, specializing in eating human flesh, the crime is so great. Dying deep in the mountains, bones exposed to the ground with no one to bury, hell punishment harsh and harsh, and having to reincarnate as an animal. Today you are fortunate enough to have the opportunity to narrate the evil actions of your past life, you have made atonement for your sins, and will be reincarnated as a human in your next life, not as a buffalo or horse, living without arms or legs, having to crawl and beg to avoid harming others.

Cop At: Thank Living Buddha Ji Cong for helping me escape from suffering.

Praying to the Buddha: That suffering is my own to endure, I have helped many people, I must know how to be self-sufficient, not be greedy.

Cop At: Yes, yes.

Duong Sinh: May I ask you, what crimes did you commit in your past life? Being a woman, can she also be reincarnated as a tiger?

Cop Bing: Please Duong Thien Sinh, don't take it funny, I regretted it but it was too late, in my past life I was a violent woman, because I was born in an undisciplined family as a child, I was arrogant and arrogant, and eventually fell into the mafia, specializing in selling drugs and keeping prostitutes to make money. In this life, I had to be reincarnated as a tigress, which was also caused by my sins.

Praying to the Buddha: You are not a human but a tigress. In this life, you are a tiger wandering in the deep mountains, but your spirit is still connected to your previous life. Cop Binh: Thank you Lord Te Buddha for saving me.

Buddhist worship: Stop interviewing tigers here, go somewhere else to interview elephants.

Duong Sinh: Yes, I am ready, I respectfully invite you to depart...

Buddha worship: Arrived.

Duong Sinh: Here there is a herd of very large elephants, with one tiny one, like a baby elephant.

Duong Sinh: So that's the reason. At this time, the herd of elephants had temporarily transformed their bodies, turning into "mahouts", that is, elephant herders, each with a fierce appearance, frightening to see.

Buddhist worship: They are all great athletes incarnated so their bodies are huge. Duong Sinh can interview them.

Duong Sinh: I am the saintly writer Duong Sinh of the Holy Duc Hall in Taichung, following in the footsteps of Living Buddha Ji Gong in writing the book Samsara Travel, interviewing to clearly see cause and effect, to encourage people. Today I'm specially here to interview you. If you tell yourself the cause of your past life to give advice to the world, it's a good opportunity to make amends. It's a good opportunity. Duong Sinh: How does it feel to be reincarnated as an elephant?

Armed Elephant: The body is large and bulky, the body is very heavy, walking takes a lot of effort, and feels very uncomfortable.

Praying to Buddha: Your body, limbs are big but you lack space to use martial arts.

Duong Sinh: Why do elephants use their trunks to pick up food and throw it into their mouths?

Duong Sinh: Creation with extraordinary divine power, everything is arranged very thoughtfully, the path of reincarnation whether you want to leave or go is up to you to choose, you can eat whatever fruit you like. Voi At: In my previous life, I grew up in the forest, I had not yet washed away all my barbarism, my ferocious temperament, my heart was brutal, I fell in love with a girl in my family, and when her parents opposed me, I got angry and killed my whole family and even cut up meat to eat to appease my anger. Duong Sinh: They look like a foreigner from a primitive tribe, with many lines on their faces, it looks really strange.

Praying to Buddha: This elephant is a very large two-toothed elephant, which is also a cannibal tooth. Human teeth are short and regular, the type of teeth given by God to eat fruits and vegetables, and the type of teeth that elephants want to eat

must have to sharpen their teeth first, they love to destroy and terrorize, humans and animals are different, we can classify them based on that. Buddhist worship: That's right, people also need to have such a spiritual life to be able to overcome a life of indulgence in pleasure, loss is taken lightly, if the opportunity comes and you don't cheerfully grasp it right away, one day it will be lost. Buddhist: Ha ha, since ancient times and modern times, we have presented the mystery of the universe in an honest way. I thought there were only two travel books: Heaven and Hell. enlightened. The Holy Duc Duong has just been established in accordance with the will of heaven. How can people be jealous because of their own desires? Therefore, being able to preside over the ashram on earth is all arranged by karma from the obscure, high realm. You should clearly understand that, break through the siege, eliminate all bad situations at the holy door, the proverb says: "If you have fate, you will gather, if you run out of fate, you will disappear." Therefore, those who teach on behalf of heaven must first purify their body and mind, like a meditator who enters concentration and has a mind that is no longer imprinted with external circumstances or bound by external conditions, a pure and empty block, transmitting true relics and words of truth. Master Mencius

said: “Completely believing in a book is better than not having a book” (Dedicated
no letter is the same as no letter). Therefore, I advise people: "Believing in fortune-telling is not as good as believing in reason." Duong Sinh: Dear teacher, your teachings are very correct, revealing many wonderful mysteries.

Te Buddha: Ha ha, I hope everyone will stay away from the wrong and evil place1, go beyond the circle of fame and profit, find Te Cong's Buddha temple, cultivate into a living Buddha's dharma body, move freely, no longer bound by external conditions. Not fair or just

Duong Sinh: Dear, I have finished preparing, I respectfully invite you to leave.

Duong Sinh: Dear Master, your teachings are very reasonable.
