tieu_de: ARTICLE FIFTEEN — AT THE “CAY CEN” BAR, A Flock of Dogs FULL OF WRATH — IN THE TRAN FAMILY WHITE DOG REPENDS ONCE'S GRACE
noi_dung:
THE ELEVEN FIFTEEN

AT THE “CANA CAN” BAR FULL OF ANGRY DOGS

WHITE LETTER DOG'S PLACE IN THE TRAN'S HOUSE GRACE IN THE AGO

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas on November 21, year of the Rooster (1981)

Poetry

Da Lai Thanh Duc Ta Kim Tien
An Noc Phi holds the great heaven
Truthful Thien Thien Thoi Opens Universally
Autumn with ten thousand benefits to train the gods.

Ho theory of worshiping Buddha dog humiliating salary
The family saves suffering from every generation
The mind longs for the great path of the world
Initiates greed for eternal success.

Translation

The Pen of the Holy Temple appears every night
All beings everywhere are blessed
Heaven is bestowing the true Dharma
All worlds quickly train the saints.

Dog meat that slanders Buddha is eaten alive
Home and family are saved from the earthly world
Hope to spread the great religion to the world
If you dare to be greedy with the fragrant scent of silkworms.

Buddhist worship: Animals and all living beings are one, because animals and humans live on earth together, they are given the right to live like humans by heaven. People know how to eat when they are hungry, when they are cold they know how to dress warmly, when they are cold they know how to feel pain, so they are also sentient beings with feelings and senses, and their lives indeed have a lot of vitality. When people no longer have life, they are nothing more than trash. How precious it is for humanity to have beloved animals born from heaven to live together with, so we must know the law of living in harmony to maintain a loving relationship. Animals in disguise help humans become actors on earth, so animals have become close companions of humans. But there is a biased minority that refuses to acknowledge this truth, leading to a scene of slaughter that leaves flesh and blood spilling out. Today, the teacher will guide Duong Sinh to interview some animals to collect living documents to promote the animal world. Duong Sinh climbed onto the lotus platform, preparing to depart.

Duong Sinh: Dear, I have finished preparing, I respectfully invite you to leave.

Buddhist worship: Having arrived, Duong Sinh got down on the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Dear, why do you immediately come down after going up to the lotus?

Buddhist worship: Sell distant brothers to buy near neighbors, today you don't need to go far, even going to the market in Taichung will reap the results.

Duong Sinh: What results did you reap?

Saying to Buddha: Ah, grilled civet meat. Look at the shop across the street, on the lantern is written the words "Moc Ton Vuong Nhuc".

Duong Sinh: Dear, I saw a tent selling dog meat set up on the side of the road. When I passed here during the day, I didn't see a market open.

Buddhist worship: The civet meat market is usually held at night when the weather is cool and attractive.

Duong Sinh: There were many dogs barking outside the shop, as if they wanted to pounce on the people in the shop, some were lying down and sleeping, some were sitting on chairs that didn't look like customers, their eyes were bloodshot, their fists banged on the table, as if intending to collect a debt from the shop owner.

Buddhist worship: Those are the original spirits of dogs that were slaughtered. After dying in frustration, they followed the flesh and blood and hid in the restaurant. The customers ate the meat and drank wine with great pleasure but did not notice that behind their backs, the unjust dog spirits barked endlessly. The person sitting on the chair and pounding the table with their fists is also the unjust soul of a dog that was killed. Because of its strong primordial spirit, it has turned into a humanoid form, extremely resentful, insisting on debt to the person who killed it. It is truly an unjust soul that cannot be dissipated.

Duong Sinh: People often say that my teacher loved to eat dog meat when he was still in the world. When he comes here today, he will surely eat a full meal.

Praying to the Buddha: Good boy, you are very skillful in making jokes, I eat dog meat but not this kind of dog meat but heavenly dog ​​meat, that is the real "kingly dishonor" and this is just mortal dog meat so how can it be called "kingly dishonor".

Duong Sinh: Why is it called heavenly dog ​​meat? It's the first time I've heard of it.

Praying to Buddha: There is a proverb that says: "Eating leprous toad meat is like wild goose meat!". As for me, I believe that mortals cannot eat the meat of heavenly dogs, so what is a heavenly dog? Why is that strange? What's more, people are wary of thieves, and there's a sign outside the gate: "Beware of ferocious dogs." In the stories written about Te Cong, the author shows readers that I am a monk who specializes in eating dog meat. Many people immediately believe it without thinking deeply. Could it be that even though I have become a monk, I can still break the precepts and break the law? The novel is just a fantasy like wine with added yeast, the reason is only because I was originally an Arhat incarnate, my Dharma was profound in my previous life, so when I was at Linh An Pagoda I was hated by many people. Every time I turn the wheel of dharma, sweet soy sauce flows all over my body, I wake up drunk and spin around with heaven and earth, so they think I'm drunk. Profane wine confuses the mind, sacred wine calms the mind, countless times

I have gritted my teeth and clenched my tongue, only occasionally saying a few sentences about meditation. I wonder what's so outrageous about it? Buying alcohol requires money, but my pockets are empty. Even though our hands are empty, when we want to drink Bodhi wine that is not regular wine, we just need to reach out and have it. Even if we don't have money, we can still pay because it is the rain of nectar dharma to bathe and awaken the pure spirit. There are worldly people who, after just drinking a few cups, become intoxicated and vomit. They become intoxicated and torture both body and soul. I am a Living Buddha and also a drunken ghost. How can I compare? As for eating dog meat, in every human being there is a dog that is truly evil, greedy and insolent, that specializes in biting its owner. If there is such a dog that doesn't kill it and instead drinks it, how long will you want to keep it? People do not understand that reason, so they accidentally keep an evil dog in their body. Every time a thief comes, it bows its head and wags its tail to happily welcome it, but when it sees its owner, it bites back immediately. I like to eat its meat very much.

Duong Sinh: In the words my teacher just taught, my teacher took the evil thoughts in people's minds as an example. That evil dog is also the primordial spirit of humans, which was pure before coming to earth and transformed into humans, so it is also called the heavenly dog. Eating heavenly dog ​​meat represents killing false thoughts, eliminating desires, and eliminating wrong views. Is that so?

The sauce is full, true energy rises like the steam of alcohol, the heart is extremely happy, completely free. The monks and nuns are sad and worried, have Bodhi seeds but don't know where to plant them, their hearts are not blooming, they are lethargic and can't stand it, this ascetic practice is unbearable, this ascetic practice is useless. I have a fan, just one fan and there will be cool, fresh wind. A pair of grass shoes, pedaling across the horizon and the sea. A felt hat covers the ears when visiting Buddha's country. Specializes in beating evil dogs to advise people about life, likes to lift a cup of good things to calm the mind, is there anything wrong? If people in this world have this power, their minds are not crazy, their limbs are not restless, and if they study the Te Gong Dharma, they will surely become Living Buddhas.

Duong Sinh: Dear Master, you have just presented the secret to cultivating the Way. Anyone with a firm heart will certainly grasp the truth. In the cold winter, many people crave to eat dog meat, because they think that the body will be warm and erectile. People with weak bodies often think so, and how does the teacher feel about eating dog meat?

Buddhist worship: Why do royal humiliation, royal humiliation attract people? Because eating it, the body is as hot as burning, but still does not know that the dog's soul groans, writhes, struggles, bites and chews, causing the blood vessels in the body to become tense, but they still think it is fattening, not knowing that it is a raging dog's nature, and they still think it is beneficial. After eating it, why spit it out? Is it better to not eat it? The ancients said: “It is better to abstain from sex than

to nourish semen.” If people didn't buy dog ​​meat and eat it, wouldn't they be sick and weak?

Duong Sinh: Dear, dog meat has no flavor, why do people call it "humiliation" which means fragrant meat?

Buddhist worship: Butchers want to sell their goods so they call dog meat "kingly disgrace" or "humiliation" just to advertise to a large number of customers. Stray dogs don't bathe all their lives and eat rotten corpses and human feces. If you smell the dog, you'll definitely feel stinky. Dog meat shop owners try advertising it as "stinky dog ​​meat" to see if there are any diners who dare to come and eat it? So it's natural for them to borrow the beautiful name "humiliation" or "royal humiliation". If they used fragrant oil to bathe the dog before slaughtering, the name "humiliation" would make some sense. Regardless of stray dogs, the meat they eat is not hygienic, because they lie on the ground, most of them are full of disease germs, it is better to advise people not to eat them. And if you want to eat it, don't say you're imitating the Buddha, because the dog meat that the Buddha eats is heavenly dog ​​meat, because you raise it yourself, bathe it every day, brush your teeth, anoint it with cotton, antiseptic and antidote, feed it medicinal vegetables at every meal, take it up the mountain for a walk every day, sleep in the same bed at night, then it's a pure dog that eats meat that is beneficial.Once a dog is close to you, a deep friendship develops, not to mention keeping the door, taking care of the house for you, and having the heart to kill a loyal relative to eat meat to fatten up your body, doesn't it turn out to be a wolf-hearted person? Such actions only benefit the body but are harmful to the mind. You will regret it for the rest of your life.

Duong Sinh: Dear, I often hear the monks slandering my teacher because he used to like to eat dog meat, but now he loudly preaches about precepts in the middle of a group of people and advises sentient beings. Isn't that against the teacher's nature? Or is it because he used to drink too much alcohol and meat, but now he has corrected his mistakes, reformed himself, made amends for his sins, and preached Dharma to save the world?

Buddhist worship: Ha ha, crazy monks chanting the main sutras makes the monks who imitate the sutras suspicious. In the past, I used the body of a Living Buddha to transform my body and mock the world. Their eyes of wisdom were not yet open. Using my eyes to look at life, I naturally drowned myself in a puddle of mud. Sentient beings were happy to listen to me preach the main sutras. Now, if they don't want to, why are they still defaming me?

Duong Sinh: The civet meat restaurant is bustling today because there are too many customers.

Buddhist worship: Because their bodies are weak, there is no way to cope, so the only way is to ask for help from dog meat.

Duong Sinh: Is dog meat very nutritious for the body?

Buddhist worship: Killing a dog will not only result in the police arrest and prosecute you for unethical and unhygienic behavior, so even if it is good, it is still bad, not good.

Duong Sinh: Sir, then what is that doctrine?

Praying to Buddha: Dogs are very loyal to humans, so they cannot bear to kill dogs for meat. Raising chickens and ducks to eat meat is common, but raising dogs to eat meat is very rare. Because dogs are rare, dog meat traders often bait the dogs to die and then bring them back for meat. That dog meat has a lot of toxins, eating it can cause many serious diseases. Stray dogs specialize in rummaging through garbage cans and eating dirty and rotten food, so they are infected with many types of bacteria. Many people, after eating this type of dog meat, are poisoned beyond treatment, so people should choose dog meat instead.

Duong Sinh: There are many dogs screaming and whining behind the shop, sir, should we interview them?

Buddhist worship: It is very necessary to interview them, maybe release them so that they can appear and preach the Dharma.

Duong Sinh: I respectfully ask for the enlightenment of the master to help us appear in human form so we can talk together.

Praying to the Buddha: “Dogs, dogs, you all have Buddha nature. Although your body is smelly, many people say your meat is fragrant. Raise your head. Before the death of the body, don't be frightened, resentful, or violent. People are not afraid of your stinky meat, but they also call it fragrant, you should be satisfied with that. Duong Sinh: After listening to the teacher's teachings, their spirituality seemed to be enlightened, so they no longer saw them barking in hatred, but ran closer to the teachers and students with tears in their eyes, kneeling down, gradually revealing human figures, men and women, clothes of all colors, white and black, coffee with milk, tears and nose running, looking very miserable.

Buddha Sacrifice: I am the Living Buddha Te Gong, serving the order to guide the holy writer Duong Thien Sinh to come here for an interview. Just now I have given Buddha Dharma hints to you, each of you should clearly recount your karma to write in the book Samsara Journey, one is to make merit to atone for sins, two is to be a living being to transcend, immeasurable merit.

Squid Dog: Thank you, Living Buddha Ji Cong, for your salvation and the gift of spiritual light. Unfortunately, we were reincarnated as dogs, eating leftover rice and gnawing bones. In the cold winter, being naked and being killed by people is truly an indescribable pain. I hope that the Living Buddha's golden words of advice and advice will help those who want to kill, sell, and those whose mouths crave food will wake up. We respectfully ask you to forgive all of our injustice!

Duong Sinh: An injustice can be resolved but cannot be forced. Your current body is no longer a living body but a fake body, so let

let them take the body, make feathers, eat meat to keep their bodies warm, isn't that very peaceful and comfortable?

Squid Dog: Easy to say but difficult to do. When killed, the pain is extremely painful, the hairs stand on end. I was born in Taiping village, Taichung district, one day while running on the street, a man holding an iron rod hit me in the head from behind, my skull was broken, blood flowed out, I fell to the ground, struggling to die. He then picked it all up and put it in the trunk of the car, in which many of his fellow creatures were also moaning pitifully. We were taken home by him. There was already a barrel of boiling water at home. One by one we were thrown into it. Some of us were still drowning. When we encountered the boiling water, we jumped up and told our friends to run away, and then gradually let go of our souls, so the hatred increased dramatically. Being dipped into boiling water, both soul and body were in pain, wanting to burst the heart and crack the lungs, then having the skin peeled off, the abdomen cut open, the sharp blade cutting the flesh was painful, extremely horrifying. After the meat is finished, people distribute it to civet meat shops, earning a lot of profit. We will report it to the King of Hell.

Buddha: Don't accuse, examine yourself to see what your previous life was like?

Squid Dog: Yes, listening to Buddha's advice, my heart calmed down completely. Recalling his previous life as an official who acted in shady affairs, specializing in corruption and bribery, when he saw that his subordinate's wife and children were beautiful, he would commit adultery. If he did not listen, he would think of a plan to harm him. There was a wife of someone under me who was very beautiful. I wanted it but couldn't get it, so I thought, first put her husband in prison, then put pressure on his wife by demanding conditions that if she sacrificed herself, she would release her husband. Because the wife loved her husband so much, she had to humiliate herself and sacrifice herself. After that, I thought that if I let the husband go, there would be no more chances, so I charged him with a more serious crime, to avoid being released from prison one day, and then lied to the wife that although I tried my best to take care of her husband, I couldn't save him, so there was no other way to release her husband. The wife clearly saw her son's cunning plan and was extremely angry and desperate, so she drank poison to commit suicide, because the son had committed this great crime, and after death he was reincarnated as a dog.

Buddhist worship: Since it was like this, now we have to sacrifice meat for others to eat, how can we still be dissatisfied? Those who eat you, don't you recognize who they are? That was the wife you raped so she committed suicide and reincarnated. The underworld arranged for that person to eat you. Forget all your anger. You see that person eats very deliciously, compared to the time when you did evil, it is not inferior to each other, that is also the cause and effect of retribution, that is why he ate your flesh like that. We've been at this civet meat restaurant for a long time, so we went somewhere else to change the atmosphere.

Duong Sinh: Where are you going?

Buddha worship: Go to house number... in alley 112 Dong Hung street, Dong Hung village, Dai Ly village, Dai Trung district, interview

Duong Sinh: Sir, please obey...

Buddhist worship: We have arrived, this is the Tran family's house, they have a patched dog, every day it follows its owner here and there, and at night sleeps in the same bed with the owner, it is truly like a shadow and a shadow, inseparable. Previously, a reader of Thanh Duc magazine brought that dog to Thanh Duc Duong, introducing that dog was very strange, different from other dogs. Duong Sinh: I really want it. The day before, Tran Tien Sinh and a fellow practitioner used a car to take that dog to the temple to worship the Immortals and Buddhas so that believers could interview it. That dog was very beautiful and gentle.

Buddhist worship: The teacher gave it a hint so that it appeared in human form and then interviewed it. "Tieu Vien, Tieu Vien is the name that the owner often addresses intimately, being together morning and night, there must be a predestined relationship, this strange dog in this world! Duong Sinh: For the sake of the dog, the monk gave enlightenment tips. After reciting the mantra, the dog gradually transformed into a girl wearing a white shirt embroidered with roses, extremely beautiful.

Buddhist worship: Good students can interview.

Duong Sinh: I am the holy writer Duong Sinh of Thanh Duc Duong in Taichung. Today, I especially followed Priest

Ngu Cam Hi

Imitate the tiger's way to fill the lungs with vitality and vitality.

Method:

2. Then crawl on your back, also crawl forward three times, crawl back twice.

Imitate the way of the deer to strengthen the functions of the spleen, stomach, liver, and kidneys.

Explanation:

Method:

1. First of all, you must be ready to crawl on the ground, tilt your head back, turn left three times, turn right twice.

2. Then the left leg stretches three times, the right leg twice.

III. HUNG HI (Imitate the bear's way)

Imitate the bear's way to calm the liver, increase the body's strength, pure spirit, and peaceful sleep.

Explanation:

The bear has a courageous personality, a strong body, and is good at using its front legs to push things and climb. While practicing, you must learn courage and how to walk boldly in order to find stillness in the movement.

Method:

1. Lie on your back, bend your body up, hug your knees with both legs, raise your neck, and use all your strength to move left and right.

2. Then turn over onto your stomach, put one hand on the ground to support your body, and then change your left hand to your right hand.

IV. PILLS (Imitate the way of gibbons)

Imitate the way of gibbons so that the brain's nerves are flexible, vitality develops, and blood vessels circulate.

Explanation:

A gibbon's movements are flexible and refined. When practicing, you must imitate the ape's agile spirit, with both hands sticking out like claws. The important thing is breathing and massage movements.

Method:

1. Do a swinging motion.

2. First, both hands firmly grasp a large round wooden stick that can be held horizontally above the head, and the body swings up and down seven times.

3. Then use your legs to replace your arms and hang upside down, then switch your right leg to your left leg, seven times.

4. Put your hands on the ground, your feet up to the sky, and do this seven times standing upside down.

V. BIRD'S WINGS (Imitate a bird's wings)

Imitate a bird's wings to help the heart avoid blockages and blood circulation.

Explanation:

Among birds, the crane symbolizes longevity, so we must imitate the movements of the white crane. The crane's light body is good at flying, and its balance is very high. Therefore, while practicing, you must learn how to fly like a crane, and coordinate various stretching movements to balance your ability and develop your respiratory function. At the same time, the head, neck, body, arms and legs must respond rhythmically according to the movements.

When the crane perches, it only uses one leg but is still steady and stable. The back slopes downward, one leg is bent up, the heel and the back of the neck are facing each other. When imitating the way a bird flies, the joints, bones and tendons of the upper body must be soft but still strong, moving quickly and slowly at the right time.

With both arms straight, bend one leg up, stretch it straight back, then do the same from the left leg to the right leg seven times.

Method:

1. Both arms are stretched out straight, one leg is bent up and stretched back like the long tail of a rooster.

2. Both hands stretched straight forward, eyes focused like an eagle's.

3. Concentrate your mind and do the same movement with your left and right legs seven times.

4. Then sit down, stretch your legs straight forward, bend your back and hold your heels with both hands, do so seven times.

5. Then stretch your arms to move your elbows, do this seven times.

The body training method of the five animals above, during the review period, the body may have pain, swelling, sweating, and itching. These are normal reactions when not exercising, don't be afraid. Below is the image of a compassionate old man. Not only is he a vegetarian, but his entire family is also vegetarian, so all the animals he raises in the house such as dogs, chickens, and ducks are considered dear friends. In the winter, he often took his grandchildren out to sit and bask in the sun in front of the house. The cattle then also huddled around him, enjoying the natural happiness. Looking at the sight of people and animals gathering so dearly like that, our hearts must be filled with joy. If the whole world were like this, it would be a universal world.

The river separates the evil and falls
The great earth is the spring of the world.

In the past there was a lot of killing
Now we all love

All pity each other.

Love animals and please don't eat them.
